articles.title: French Fry-Sized Fish Climbs a 50-Foot Waterfall!
articles.summary: Tiny shellear fish, no bigger than a French fry, climb straight up the 50-foot Luvilombo Falls in Africa. Their secret? Front fins covered in microscopic hooks that work like Velcro. The journey can take 10 hours!

articles.title: Tennis Besties Patten and Heliovaara Win Wimbledon Again!
articles.summary: Henry Patten and Harri Heliovaara won their second Wimbledon men's doubles title, beating Arevalo and Pavic in two tie-breaks. Patten called Heliovaara 'the best partner in the world' and even did a forward roll to celebrate!

articles.title: The Woman Who Built 1969 Hollywood for the Big Screen Has Died
articles.summary: Barbara Ling, the Oscar-winning designer who built 1969 Hollywood for 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,' has died at 73. She also worked on Batman movies and a Michael Jackson film.
